reports.title: Shakahola: Mackenzie Jailed for 200 Years Over 191 Murders
reports.description:
The High Court in Mombasa has sentenced preacher Paul Mackenzie to 200 years in prison after convicting him on 191 counts of murder over the Shakahola Forest deaths in Kilifi County, where 191 people — including 190 children — died between 2021 and 2023. Justice Diana Kavedza delivered the sentence; the prosecution had sought the death penalty.

Mahakama Kuu ya Mombasa imemhukumu Paul Mackenzie kifungo cha miaka 200 gerezani baada ya kumpata na hatia ya mauaji 191 katika msitu wa Shakahola, Kaunti ya Kilifi.
